text: i see so the entirety of the model when on the stage here is just a linear array and not keyed to the outliner? just seems to be the most fragile approach if so, why wouldit it be "0":[],"1":[].......
resolution: Design question, answered with an assessment (no code change): explained that the stage model is one flat triangle-soup buffer + per-face authored group ids (n-gon identity) with outliner parts as [lo,hi) SPANS over that id space — ownership is an arithmetic convention, which is the fragility req_3029 exposed. Explained why the flat buffer is load-bearing (GPU/paint/weld/cross-part ops) and why keyed face lists would be worse (face indices are positional and shift every topo op). Recommended the robust rework if this bites again: an explicit group→part table replacing spans, making overlap unrepresentable; partIndexOf/renormalize already centralize the lookup so it is localized in concept but touches every grouping op, journal, meshdoc serialization, and the __mesh_part_ranges cart mirror. Deferred pending the user's word.
